skills.name: Enflame
skills.description: Blue flames come out of Soji's smartphone and cover him. Good effects on allies.  *attack range +20% (10 sec) *Allies' Skill Range +30% (10 sec)

skills.name: Demon Flame Flying Axe Kick
skills.description: Jumps up high, leg wrapped in demon flames, and swings it down on enemies. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -60% (6 sec) *Makes enemy skills unusable (6 sec) *ATK x 4500% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: Dead Account
abilities.description: Dead Account Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Ally Clone+
abilities.description: Has a high chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy. - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
